entities.summary: "Poison Cake" is a song by Bosnian Croat singer-songwriter Marko Bošnjak. Described as a story of revenge and standing up for oneself, the song was released on 10 January 2025 through Aquarius. It was written by Bošnjak, together with Bas Wissink, Ben Pyne, Emma Gale, and Filip Majdak. The song represented Croatia in the Eurovision Song Contest 2025.
